sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very closely related to M. percomis but evidently a distinct species. It differs from that species as follows: the head is larger, the compound eyes larger, the fontanelle lanceolate, the antennae 16-segmented; the pronotum is broader; the wings and abdominal tergites are mostly darker. Antennal segment 1 usually dark; segment 3 the smallest; segment 4 slightly longer and wider than segment 3; segments 5 and 6 equal in length; segment 7 slightly longer than segment 6; the remaining segments long and narrow. The hairs on the head, thorax and abdomen are very short (Figs. 4, 320). Measurements (mm): length with wings 10.25; length without wings 5.00—5.30; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.21—1.24; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.64—0.66; head width 1.17—1.21; maximum diameter of compound eye 0.38—0.40; ocellus length 0.18; pronotum length 0.55—0.66; pronotum width 1.10—1.17; fore wing length 8.00—8.30; fore wing width 2.30—2.60.

note: Rewritten from the new-species description in Hill (1942); the original is in English. Distribution: Queensland, near Cunnamulla. Described from only a few alates (probably taken at light indoors); the holotype is in C.S.I.R.; soldier and worker are unknown. Measurements in mm. OCR problems: in the original "3th and 6th equal", the "3th" is a misreading of 5th, and the text has been transcribed as segments 5 and 6 equal; "G. S. I.R. Collection" is a misreading of "C.S.I.R. Collection".
